description: This file provides a helper utility class for Firebase Cloud Messaging integration in a Flutter app, including initialization, permission request, and device token retrieval.

classes.name: FirebaseMessagingService
classes.description: A helper class to manage Firebase Cloud Messaging setup, permissions, and device token retrieval within a Flutter app.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures Firebase is initialized; safe to call multiple times, with internal state to prevent re-initialization.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests notification permissions on iOS and macOS; returns the settings or null on failure.

methods.name: getDeviceToken
methods.description: Fetches the FCM registration token for the device after ensuring proper initialization and permissions.
